Yoruba: Ṣáájú ọdún 1996, àwọn èèyàn San ò rí àtìlẹ́yìn láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn àjọ àti àwọn ìgbékalẹ̀ tí ó lè dáàbò bo àwọ̀n nǹkan tí wọ́n fẹ́.
Zulu: Ngaphambi kuka-1996, abantu bohlanga lwe-San nabo babentula ukwesekwa yizinhlangano nezikhungo ezazingavikela izintshisekelo zabo.

Source: As a result, the relationship between researchers and the San people was not always equal, and some researchers exploited San people.
Luganda: Olw’embeera eyo, enkolagana wakati w’abanoonyereza n’Abasaani yalinga teyenkanankana, era abanoonyereza abamu baanyuunyunta Abasaani.
Yoruba: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àbájáde, ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín àwọn aṣèwádìí àti àwọn èèyàn San ò dọ́gba, àti pé àwọn aṣèwádìí kọ̀ọ̀kan yan àwọn èèyàn San jẹ.
Zulu: Ngenxa yalokho, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabacwaningi nabantu bohlanga lwe-San babungalingani ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi abanye abacwaningi babexhaphaza abantu abangamaSan.
Hausa: A sakamakon haka, dangantakar da take tsakanin masu bincike da mutanen San ba ko yaushe take daidai ba, kuma wasu masu binciken sun ci da gumin mutanen San.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka la se, kamano magareng ga banyakišiši le Masarwa e be e sa dule e lekana, gomme banyakišiši ba bangwe ba ile ba tlaiša Masarwa.
Amharic: በውጤቱም፣ በተመራማሪዎች እና በሳን ህዝቦች መካከል የነበረው ግንኙነት ሁልጊዜ እኩል አልነበረም፣ እና አንዳንድ ተመራማሪዎች የሳን ሰዎችን በዝብዘዋል።

Source: The San Code of Research Ethics was therefore created to ensure that researchers act with fairness and integrity when dealing with them.
Luganda: Noolwekyo amateeka g’Abasaani ageekuusa ku mpisa ezigobererwa mu kukola okunoonyereza gaateekebwawo okukakasa nti abanoonyereza bakozesa obwenkanya n’obwesimbu nga bakolagana nabo.
Yoruba: A ṣẹ̀dá Kóòdù San Ìwádìí Ìwà ọmọlúàbí láti rí i dájú pé àwọn aṣèwádìí hùwà pẹ̀lú òtítọ́ àti òdodo nínú ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú wọn.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke I-San Code of Research Ethics yadalelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abacwaningi benza ngokungenzeleli nangobuqotho lapho besebenzisana nabo.
Hausa: Don haka, an ƙirƙiri Ɗa’ar Dokar Bincike ta San don tabbatar da cewa masu bincike suna aiki da gaskiya da mutunci a yayin mu'amala da su.
Northern Sotho: Molawana wa Maitshwaro wa Dinyakišišo ka ga Masarwa ka fao o hlamilwe go netefatša gore banyakišiši ba itshwara ka go loka le ka seriti ge ba dirišana le bona.

Source: In this study, researchers documented the process of drafting the code.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baawandiika emitendera egyayitibwamu mu kubaga amateeka.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn ìlànà ìgbìyànjú kíkọ kóòdù náà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babhala inqubo yokubhala ikhodi.

Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba ngwadile tshepedišo ya go ngwala melawana ye.

Source: They said San leaders met during 3 workshops to discuss issues facing their people.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abakulembeze b’Abasaani baasisinkana mu nkuŋŋaana za mirundu 3 okuteesa ku bintu abantu baabwe bye bayitamu.

Zulu: Bathe abaholi babantu be-San bahlangana ezingqungqutheleni ezi-3 zokudingida izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu babo.

Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore baetapele ba Masarwa ba ile ba kopana ka diwekešopong tše 3 go ahlaahla mathata ao batho ba bona ba lebanego le ona.

Source: The San were supported in this by two non-profit organisations, the South African San Institute (SASI) and the South African San Council (SASC).
Luganda: Mu kino, Abasaani baayambibwako ebitongole by’obwannakyewa bibiri, ekitongole kya South African San Institute (SASI) n’ekya South African San Council (SASC).

Northern Sotho: Masarwa a thekgilwe go se ke mekgatlo ye mebedi ya go se dire letseno, e lego Mokgatlo wa Masarwa wa Afrika Borwa (SASI) le Lekgotla la Masarwa la Afrika Borwa (SASC).

Source: The San representatives were particularly interested in how to encourage fair research partnerships, especially in areas where communities don’t have a deep understanding of research or could be exploited because of poverty.
Luganda: Abakiise b’Abasaani okusinga baali batunuulidde okulaba engeri y’okuteekawo enkolagana ezirimu obwenkanya mu kunoonyereza, naddala mu bitundu omuli abantu abatamanyi kinene nnyo bikwata ku kunoonyereza oba mu bitundu abantu mwe bayinza okunyuunyuntibwa olw’obwavu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣojú San nífẹ̀ẹ́ pàtàkì nínú ọ̀nà tí wọ́n fì lè gba ìyànjú ìwádìí àjọṣepọ̀, pàápàá jùlọ ní àwọn apá àwọn agbègbè tí kò ní ìmọ̀ tó kẹnú nípa iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tàbí tí a lè yànjẹ torí òṣì.
Zulu: Abamele ama-San babenentshisekelo enkulu yokuthi kungagqugquzelwa kanjani ubudlelwano bocwaningo obunobulungiswa, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho imiphakathi ingenakho ukuqonda okujulile ngocwaningo noma engase ixhashazwe ngenxa yobumpofu.

Northern Sotho: Baemedi ba Masarwa ba be ba tloga ba na le kgahlego mabapi le ka fao ba ka hlohleletšago dikamano tša dinyakišišo tše di lokilego, kudukudu ka makaleng ao ditšhaba di hlokago kwešišo yeo e tseneletšego ya dinyakišišo goba fao e lego gore b aka šomišwa bošaedi ka lebaka la bohloki bja bona.

Source: They identified key principles that they felt were important for any research involving their people.

Source: They said researchers should act with respect and fairness, and should care for the community they worked with, and be honest about their research goals.

Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ó yẹ kí àwọn aṣèwádìí hùwà pẹ̀lú ọ̀wọ̀ àti òdodo, àti pé kí wọ́n ṣe ìtọ́jú àgbègbè tí wọ́n bá ṣiṣẹ́, àti jẹ́ olóòótọ́ nínú àfojúsùn Ìwàdíí wọn.
Zulu: Bathe abacwaningi kufanele benze ngenhlonipho nangokungakhethi, futhi banakekele umphakathi abasebenza nawo, futhi bathembeke ngezinhloso zabo zocwaningo.

Source: They also added that researchers should follow the correct processes, as set out by the San Council, when doing any research with San communities.
Luganda: Baayongerako ne bagamba nti abanoonyereza basaanye bagoberere emitendera emituufu, nga bwe gyateekebwawo Akakiiko k’Abasaani, nga bakola okunoonyereza kwonna n’Abasaani.

Source: The principles of fairness, respect, caring and honesty were then used as subsections to create the final San Code of Research Ethics.
